metadata.title: भुसुर बाज़ार में लक्ष्मी टोप्पो के हाथ का चिकन | Chicken Cooked in Tribal Market
metadata.description:
In the heart of Bhusur, a picturesque village near Ranchi, Jharkhand, lies a vibrant marketplace where the Oraon tribe and neighboring communities gather every Monday. This bustling market is not just a place for trade but a hub of cultural exchange and community bonding. Among the diverse offerings, culinary delights steal the show, with fresh chicken, pork, fish, and mutton cooked over traditional firewood stoves. In a captivating episode, viewers are invited to witness Laxmi, a local Oraon woman, showcase her culinary prowess as she prepares a traditional chicken dish. The scene captures not only the essence of Oraon cuisine but also the rich cultural tapestry of the region.

Anchor - Shyam Sunder
